# Yash Khalkar — Software Engineer & Backend-Focused Full-Stack Developer

> Official website and software engineering portfolio of Yash Khalkar.
> URL: https://yashkhalkar.vercel.app/

---

## About

Yash Khalkar is a software engineer and backend-focused full-stack developer based in Nashik, India. He specializes in backend engineering, full-stack web development, mobile application development, APIs, databases, system design, cloud technologies, and modern software systems.

He is a full-stack JavaScript developer focused on building practical web applications from user-facing interfaces to backend flows and deployment. His work spans products, admin panels, onboarding flows, and machine-learning applications.

As a former Tech Community Leader (GDG On Campus Lead at MET), he has led 12+ events and co-organized Hacktoberfest Nashik '24, drawing 600+ registrations and 300+ active contributors.

---

## Experience

### SWE (Backend Engineer) — Skillminds LLP
- **Period**: 2026 – Present
- **Location**: Nashik, India
- **Product**: Pheraas
- **Responsibilities**: Owning backend architecture, REST APIs, data modeling, authentication, and core product workflows. Working closely on feature delivery, implementation details, and production-ready behavior across the main backend surface area.

### Frontend Intern — Zenzop
- **Period**: 2025
- **Location**: Remote
- **Responsibilities**: Built and launched the Admin Panel and company Landing Page with Onboarding flow. Developed key back-end routes to enable seamless product functionality. Contributed as a founding developer, collaborating closely with the core team.

### AI Intern — Infosys Springboard Internship 5.0
- **Period**: 2024
- **Location**: Remote
- **Responsibilities**: Completed a structured internship focused on practical machine learning applications in healthcare. Worked in a project-based learning environment replicating industry-level workflows and collaboration.
